newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Clintons snorkel at Great Barrier Reef.
newsitem.headline: Clintons snorkel at Great Barrier Reef.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton and his wife Hillary spent about one hour snorkeling on Friday at the Great Barrier Reef, an experience he called "unforgettable".

The Clintons, accompanied by what a spokeswoman would only describe as "a lot" of Secret Service agents, went to a site about 30 miles off the coast in the Coral Sea, and swam above the coral and brightly coloured fish that make up the natural wonder.
"This was just an unforgettable day," Clinton told White House Deputy Press Secretary Mary Ellen Glynn. "Magnificent."
"He clearly was having a wonderful time," Glynn said, noting that both the president and first lady had waterproof cameras with them and took pictures of the coral formations.

The outing lasted more than five hours and was one of Clinton's last chances to relax before departing on Saturday for the Philippines, where he will participate in the annual gathering of the leaders of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum.
